data.title: North Carolina teen accused of using AI for sexual exploitation. Are state laws strong enough?
data.description: A boy, whose name is not public because of his age, faces multiple felony charges and is accused of using AI to create sexually explicit photos of teen girls.
data.author: Alex Littlehales, WRAL enterprise reporter
data.keywords: artificial intelligence, crime, child pornography, WRAL investigates, family, child sex abuse
